notes: Ordered low to high. Privileges are the mechanical hooks; koku and descriptions are lore. 'Koshogumi' appears twice in the source list (senior attendant and first-rank retainer); both are kept under distinct ids pending confirmation. The three garbled provincial-lord lines were split into Jun-kokushu, Kunimochi-nami and Kokushu.

ranks.title: Umamawari
ranks.description: Third-rank retainer. Right to wear two swords.

ranks.title: Churo
ranks.description: Second-rank retainer. Two swords; rides a horse in war.

ranks.title: Koshogumi (first-rank retainer)
ranks.description: First-rank retainer. Two swords; rides a horse in war and peace.

ranks.title: Hatamoto
ranks.description: Banner Knight. Carries the lord's banner in the field.

ranks.title: Mujo Daimyo
ranks.description: Lord without a castle. Yearly income 10,000 to 20,000 koku.

ranks.title: Jun-kokushu (Tozama) Daimyo
ranks.description: Outer lord ranked alongside provincial lords.

ranks.title: Kunimochi-nami (Fudai) Daimyo
ranks.description: Hereditary lord treated as a province holder.

privilegeRules.twoSwords: +50 ATK on reaction attacks (zone-of-control and Overwatch strikes).
privilegeRules.mounted: 'war' grants +1 Movement while any enemy is within 6 hexes; 'always' grants +1 Movement unconditionally.
privilegeRules.commandRadiusBonus: Added to the unit's command radius for auras and morale recovery.
privilegeRules.banner: Platoon members inside command radius recover +5 additional Morale in the Command Phase.
privilegeRules.castle: Allies inside command radius standing on Fortification gain a further +100 DEF.
privilegeRules.supreme: Reserved for campaign scale; not used in the vertical slice.
